personal.name: Jinwon Lee
personal.title: AI Platform SW · SRE
personal.motto: Build it first, then think it through.

summary: At Samsung Electronics, I work on SRE and platform engineering for generative AI services and internal LLM platforms. For about eight years, I have built and operated Kubernetes-based services, cloud infrastructure automation, CI/CD, observability, and AI evaluation/serving workflows.

My strength is taking AI applications beyond "working code" and turning them into systems that real users can rely on. I consider deployment, authentication, monitoring, incident response, and resource constraints together to build platforms where applications can run smoothly and reliably.

projects.title: Global B2C Generative AI Service
projects.description: Production generative AI service on Azure with model-serving operations, multi-region readiness, and Kubernetes governance.
projects.detailedDescription: Architected and managed a global-scale B2C generative AI service on Microsoft Azure in collaboration with KT and Microsoft. The work covered network design, multi-region deployment readiness, AI serving efficiency, security policy, and Kubernetes governance for production AI workloads.
projects.problem: Prepare a consumer-facing generative AI service for global production rollout.
projects.role: Owned platform/SRE design across Azure, Kubernetes operations, model-serving delivery flow, and governance.
projects.engineering: AI serving efficiency, multi-region deployment, GitOps delivery, network design, and security policy.
projects.outcome: Built an operating model for secure and scalable production AI service delivery.
projects.relevance: Strong fit for AI Platform Software roles that build and optimize large-scale AI services.

projects.title: Company-wide AI Chatbot Platform (30K Users)
projects.description: Enterprise AI chatbot platform serving 30,000 employees with Kubernetes, MLOps-style operations, and data protection.
projects.detailedDescription: Led the operation of a company-wide AI chatbot platform serving 30,000 employees on Microsoft Azure. Responsibilities covered end-to-end infrastructure, platform, and application operations on Kubernetes while meeting internal security, authentication, and data protection standards.
projects.problem: Provide a reliable internal AI assistant platform for tens of thousands of employees.
projects.role: Led infrastructure, platform, and AI application operations across development, staging, and production clusters.
projects.engineering: Kubernetes operations, Helm/Helmfile IaC, AI service delivery, authentication, and data protection compliance.
projects.outcome: Supported a company-wide AI service with production-grade operating standards.
projects.relevance: Shows cloud-scale AI platform operation, a core requirement for Platform Software and MLOps-facing roles.

projects.title: Enterprise AI Services Infrastructure
projects.description: MLOps and SRE operations for browser-integrated AI and Document LLM services with auth and AI observability.
projects.detailedDescription: Led SRE operations for multiple high-traffic enterprise AI services on Kubernetes and Azure. Services include browser-integrated AI platform and Document LLM platform serving thousands of employees. Implemented enterprise-grade authentication frameworks using Keycloak and OAuth, and designed comprehensive observability frameworks using Langfuse for AI application monitoring and performance tracking.
projects.problem: Operate multiple internal AI services with enterprise authentication and visibility into AI behavior.
projects.role: Handled MLOps/SRE operations and platform integration for AI applications running on Kubernetes and Azure.
projects.engineering: Keycloak/OAuth authentication, Langfuse AI observability, Kubernetes runtime operations, and Python automation.
projects.outcome: Improved operational control for AI services where security, serving health, and runtime visibility matter.
projects.relevance: Connects LLM application operations with platform software, model serving, security, and observability skills.

projects.title: Kubernetes Cluster Automation
projects.description: One-click Kubernetes cluster provisioning for repeatable developer and test environments.
projects.detailedDescription: Developed an automated one-click provisioning system for Kubernetes clusters, providing cloud developers with streamlined, ready-to-use development environments. The work reduced manual setup and made cluster creation more repeatable for development and experimentation.
projects.problem: Cloud developers needed repeatable Kubernetes environments without manual setup overhead.
projects.role: Designed and implemented provisioning automation for Kubernetes clusters and shared platform modules.
projects.engineering: IaC-driven provisioning, Python automation, reusable cluster modules, and developer environment standardization.
projects.outcome: Reduced manual operations and improved environment consistency for cloud development workflows.
projects.relevance: Highlights platform automation and infrastructure repeatability needed in large engineering organizations.

projects.title: LLM Performance Evaluation Pipeline
projects.description: MLOps-style evaluation pipeline for LLM quality and performance across Machine Translation tasks.
projects.detailedDescription: Built an automated pipeline for evaluating the performance and quality of LLM models across Machine Translation tasks. The pipeline tracked benchmark results and quality metrics with MLflow to support repeatable model comparison.
projects.problem: LLM model quality needed repeatable evaluation rather than ad hoc manual checks.
projects.role: Built the evaluation workflow and metric tracking path for Machine Translation model comparison.
projects.engineering: Python evaluation automation, PyTorch-based workloads, MLflow metric tracking, and Kubernetes execution.
projects.outcome: Made LLM evaluation results easier to compare and reproduce across model candidates.
projects.relevance: Maps directly to AI workload evaluation, model performance analysis, and MLOps pipeline needs.

projects.title: GitOps CI/CD Pipeline with ArgoCD
projects.description: GitOps-based delivery pipelines for containerized AI/platform services with Python automation and DevSecOps checks.
projects.detailedDescription: Engineered GitOps-based CI/CD pipelines using ArgoCD and Python, integrating automated security protocols such as static code analysis and container image scanning for secure software delivery.
projects.problem: Containerized AI/platform services needed repeatable, auditable, and secure deployment workflows.
projects.role: Designed delivery automation and connected AI service deployment pipelines with security verification steps.
projects.engineering: ArgoCD GitOps, GitHub Actions, Docker image handling, Kubernetes deployment, and Python glue automation.
projects.outcome: Improved deployment consistency and reduced reliance on manual release operations.
projects.relevance: Directly supports AI platform software roles that require reliable release engineering and serving operations automation.

projects.title: Centralized Monitoring & Observability Stack
projects.description: Centralized observability stack for system metrics, container runtime metrics, dashboards, and alerts.
projects.detailedDescription: Deployed a centralized monitoring environment using Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry to gather system metrics and Docker runtime metrics. Implemented dashboards and alerting rules to support proactive incident management.
projects.problem: Production services needed shared visibility into system behavior and container runtime health.
projects.role: Built the monitoring path and dashboards used for platform and service operations.
projects.engineering: Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, OpenTelemetry signals, Loki logging, and alert rules.
projects.outcome: Improved operational visibility for incident detection and runtime analysis.
projects.relevance: Observability is central to reliable AI/platform systems and manufacturing-grade service operations.

projects.title: High-throughput Packet Mirroring Application
projects.description: Real-time packet mirroring application that forwarded up to 130,000 packets/sec under constrained resources.
projects.detailedDescription: Developed an application that mirrors up to 130,000 packets per second in real time and forwards them to a target server within constrained system resources. This work emphasizes system-level performance, resource awareness, and reliable data movement.
projects.problem: Network/application teams needed real-time packet forwarding under limited system resources.
projects.role: Implemented the packet mirroring application and tuned it for resource-constrained operation.
projects.engineering: High-throughput I/O, Linux runtime behavior, resource limits, and real-time data forwarding.
projects.outcome: Delivered a system component capable of forwarding up to 130,000 packets/sec.
projects.relevance: Strengthens System Software fit through Linux runtime behavior, high-throughput data movement, and resource-aware performance work.

projects.title: Distributed CNN Training System
projects.description: Research on accelerated CNN distributed deep learning with automatic resource-aware layer placement.
projects.detailedDescription: Research on accelerated training for CNN distributed deep learning through automatic resource-aware layer placement. Published in USENIX NSDI 2019 and arXiv. Achieved up to 2.3x speedup in training time.
projects.problem: Distributed CNN training suffered from network bottlenecks and inefficient layer placement.
projects.role: Contributed to research on resource-aware placement for distributed TensorFlow/CNN training.
projects.engineering: Distributed systems, model parallelism, resource-aware scheduling, TensorFlow, and GPU-aware workloads.
projects.outcome: Published research artifacts including USENIX NSDI 2019 poster and arXiv paper; reported up to 2.3x training speedup.
projects.relevance: Shows AI systems depth beyond application code, especially distributed training, workload analysis, and resource optimization.

projects.title: Siri-like AI Assistant on TmaxOS
projects.description: AI assistant with system-level integration and natural user experience.
projects.detailedDescription: Built a Siri-like AI assistant on TmaxOS, focusing on system-level integration, AI model inference, and data preprocessing. Designed an asynchronous architecture to enable smooth and natural user experiences.
projects.problem: The OS environment needed an AI assistant that could connect user interaction with system-level capabilities.
projects.role: Built AI inference and preprocessing flows and integrated them with TmaxOS-level behavior.
projects.engineering: Async architecture, system integration, AI model inference, and data preprocessing.
projects.outcome: Delivered an AI assistant experience with smoother interaction through asynchronous design.
projects.relevance: Connects AI application development with platform software, async runtime behavior, and system integration.
